dct_creator_sm: Global Water Futures, University of Waterloo.
dct_description_sm: This dataset provides an improved set of forcing data for large scale hydrological models for climate change impacts assessment in the Mackenzie River Basin (MRB). This data set will be used to support the objectives under the  Global Water Futures Program funded by Canada First Research Excellence Fund.
dct_title_s: High-Resolution Meteorological Forcing Data for Hydrological Modelling and Climate Change Impact Analysis in Mackenzie River Basin, Canada 1979-2016
